name: Invoice
definition: General information about an invoice, such as number, issue date date and monetary amounts.

CreditDebitNoteAmount.name: Credit Debit Note Amount
CreditDebitNoteAmount.definition: Amount of credit/debit note related to the invoice.

TotalTaxAmount.name: Total Tax Amount
TotalTaxAmount.definition: Sum of all tax amounts related to the invoice. It is derived from the association between line item and tax.

TotalInvoiceAmount.name: Total Invoice Amount
TotalInvoiceAmount.definition: Total amount of the invoice, being the sum of total invoice lines amounts, total invoice additional amounts (allowances and charges) and total tax amounts.

InvoiceCurrency.name: Invoice Currency
InvoiceCurrency.definition: Code specifying the currency of the invoice.

TotalCharge.name: Total Charge
TotalCharge.definition: Algebraical sum of charges related to the invoice.

TotalPrepaidAmount.name: Total Prepaid Amount
TotalPrepaidAmount.definition: Monetary value of the total prepaid amount being reported for this settlement.

TotalNetAmount.name: Total Net Amount
TotalNetAmount.definition: Total amount after taxes, adjustments and charges.

BillingCompensationType.name: Billing Compensation Type
BillingCompensationType.definition: Defines the type of billing compensation.

BillingCompensationAmount.name: Billing Compensation Amount
BillingCompensationAmount.definition: Specifies the compensation amount of an incorrect billing.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates the direction of the invoice amount.

LimitedPresentmentIndicator.name: Limited Presentment Indicator
LimitedPresentmentIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the creditor allows limited presentment of the invoice, that is, only the invoice data needed for payment initiation.

ActivationRequestDeliveryParty.name: Activation Request Delivery Party
ActivationRequestDeliveryParty.definition: Creditor's electronic invoice provider address to which the debtor activation has to be delivered.

PeriodCovered.name: Period Covered
PeriodCovered.definition: Specifies the period covered by an invoice for instance for recurring services.

TradeSettlement.name: Trade Settlement
TradeSettlement.definition: Specifies the process which takes place to settle an invoice.

LineItem.name: Line Item
LineItem.definition: Unit of information  showing the related  provision of products and/or services and monetary summations reported as a discrete line item.

CurrencyExchange.name: Currency Exchange
CurrencyExchange.definition: Specifies currency exchange information which is used when currency conversion is necessary.

InvoicePartyRole.name: Invoice Party Role
InvoicePartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of invoices.

OriginalInvoice.name: Original Invoice
OriginalInvoice.definition: Invoice to which another invoice is associated.

RelatedInvoice.name: Related Invoice
RelatedInvoice.definition: Specifies another invoice linked to the current one, for instance a previous invoice for which a credit note is available.

InvoiceFinancingTransaction.name: Invoice Financing Transaction
InvoiceFinancingTransaction.definition: Financing transaction related to an invoice.

InvoiceStatus.name: Invoice Status
InvoiceStatus.definition: Status of the invoice or of the billing process.

RelatedElectronicInvoiceProcessingServic.name: Related Electronic Invoice Processing Service
RelatedElectronicInvoiceProcessingServic.definition: Specifies the details for the service for the invoice.
